title: The lint test proves a kb/-prefixed article path is linted, not only that no refusal fires
goal: test_live_kb.py's lint test asserts that a kb/<root>/<path> argument lints the planted article and names its finding, so a qualified() that stopped rewriting the prefix fails the suite, not only the item check of BG-wrzxhd4q (SP-7nv2ffr2 review).
